t: This is 20 Rosecroft Avenue, a building in Camden. It's a quiet residential spot, and the thing the record gives us about it is that the photojournalist James Jarché died here. Jarché was a British press photographer, born around 1890 and gone in 1965. That's about all the material says, so I won't dress it up. If you're standing outside, you're at the last address of someone whose working life was spent taking news photographs for the public to see.
